name: browser_open
title: Open browser
description: Open a reusable stealthy browser session. Pass per-request options to `browser_fetch`.

session_id.description: Custom ID; a random 12-character hex ID if omitted.

timezone_id.description: Browser timezone; uses the system timezone if omitted.

locale.description: Browser language, Accept-Language, and formatting locale; system default if omitted.

useragent.description: User-Agent override; otherwise generated in headless mode, native in headful mode.

proxy.description: Proxy URL, or dictionary with server and optional username/password.

cdp_url.description: Connect to an existing Chromium browser over CDP in a new context; launch settings do not apply.

executable_path.description: Absolute Chromium-compatible executable path; overrides the server default.

cookies.description: Initial cookies as Playwright cookie dictionaries.

block_webrtc.description: Disable non-proxied WebRTC UDP to reduce IP leaks.

allow_webgl.description: Enable WebGL; disabling it can trigger bot detection.

additional_args.description: Browser context options that override Scrapling settings.

name: browser_save_state
title: Save browser state
description: Save browser cookies, local storage and IndexedDB as Playwright-compatible JSON. Excludes sessionStorage.

session_id.description: ID from `browser_open`; no page fetch required.

path.description: File on the MCP server host; relative to its working directory. Overwrites the file; parent must exist.

name: browser_load_state
title: Load browser state
description:
Replace browser cookies, local storage and IndexedDB from a Playwright-compatible JSON file.

Leaves sessionStorage and open tabs unchanged. Fetch or reload pages to use the restored login.

session_id.description: ID from `browser_open`; no page fetch required.

path.description: File on the MCP server host; relative to its working directory.

name: open_request_session
title: Open HTTP session
description: Open a reusable HTTP session for `session_make_request`, keeping cookies, connections, and request settings.

session_id.description: Custom ID; a random 12-character hex ID if omitted.

impersonate.description: Browser/version to impersonate; "chrome" uses the latest supported Chrome profile. Lists pick randomly per attempt; None disables impersonation.

proxy.description: Proxy URL for all session requests, optionally including credentials.

name: close_session
title: Close session
description: Close a session and free its resources.

name: list_sessions
title: List sessions
description: List registered sessions, their status, and effective settings.

name: make_request
title: Send HTTP request
description: Make an HTTP request without JavaScript. Suitable for low-to-mid protection.

impersonate.description: Browser/version to impersonate; "chrome" uses the latest supported Chrome profile. Lists pick randomly per attempt; None disables impersonation.

main_content_only.description: Sanitize <body> content before selection; False uses the full document.

data.description: Form or raw body; ignored for GET.

follow_redirects.description: "safe" blocks redirects to private/internal IPs; True allows all; False disables redirects.

retries.description: Maximum attempts, including the first; None or values below 1 send once.

http3.description: Use HTTP/3; may conflict with browser impersonation.

stealthy_headers.description: Fill missing browser headers and use a Google referer if none was supplied.

name: browser_fetch_once
title: Fetch page in browser
description: Fetch a page with a stealth browser and JavaScript rendering.

main_content_only.description: Sanitize <body> content before selection; False uses the full document.

google_search.description: Set a Google referer, overriding any supplied referer.

wait.description: Extra milliseconds after the page is ready, before returning.

proxy.description: Proxy URL, or dictionary with server and optional username/password.

timezone_id.description: Browser timezone; uses the system timezone if omitted.

locale.description: Browser language, Accept-Language, and formatting locale; system default if omitted.

useragent.description: User-Agent override; otherwise generated in headless mode, native in headful mode.

cdp_url.description: Connect to an existing Chromium browser over CDP in a new context; launch settings do not apply.

executable_path.description: Absolute Chromium-compatible executable path; overrides the server default.

timeout.description: Navigation and page-operation timeout in milliseconds.

disable_resources.description: Block font, image, media, beacon, object, imageset, texttrack, websocket, csp_report, and stylesheet requests.

wait_selector.description: Wait for the first CSS match; continue if the wait fails.

cookies.description: Initial cookies as Playwright cookie dictionaries.

network_idle.description: Try to wait for 500 ms without network activity; continue if the wait fails.

block_webrtc.description: Disable non-proxied WebRTC UDP to reduce IP leaks.

allow_webgl.description: Enable WebGL; disabling it can trigger bot detection.

solve_cloudflare.description: Attempt to solve Cloudflare Turnstile/interstitial challenges before returning.

additional_args.description: Browser context options that override Scrapling settings.

name: browser_fetch
title: Fetch in browser session
description: Fetch a URL in an open stealthy browser session. Options apply only to this request.

extraction_type.description: Content output format; snapshots include element bounding boxes.

css_selector.description: Select after `main_content_only` filtering; snapshots require exactly one match.

main_content_only.description: Sanitize <body> before selection; False uses the full document. Ignored for snapshots.

wait.description: Extra milliseconds after the page is ready, before returning.

timeout.description: Navigation and page-operation timeout in milliseconds.

google_search.description: Set a Google referer, overriding any supplied referer.

network_idle.description: Try to wait for 500 ms without network activity; continue if the wait fails.

disable_resources.description: Block font, image, media, beacon, object, imageset, texttrack, websocket, csp_report, and stylesheet requests.

wait_selector.description: Wait for the first CSS match; continue if the wait fails.

blocked_domains.description: Block requests to these domains and their subdomains.

solve_cloudflare.description: Attempt to solve Cloudflare Turnstile/interstitial challenges.

pierce_shadow.description: Include open Shadow DOM content; ignored for snapshots.

name: session_make_request
title: Send HTTP request in HTTP session
description: Make an HTTP request using the session's cookies, connections, impersonation, and proxy. Options apply to this request.

main_content_only.description: Sanitize <body> content before selection; False uses the full document.

data.description: Form or raw body; ignored for GET.

follow_redirects.description: "safe" blocks redirects to private/internal IPs; True allows all; False disables redirects.

retries.description: Maximum attempts, including the first; None or values below 1 send once.

http3.description: Use HTTP/3; may conflict with browser impersonation.

stealthy_headers.description: Fill missing browser headers and use a Google referer if none was supplied.

name: browser_extract
title: Extract page content
description:
Read the current page or one element as snapshot, HTML, Markdown, or text without navigating.
Return plain text; snapshot search keeps refs, ancestor paths and three lines of nearby context.

extraction_type.description: Output format; defaults to an AI ARIA snapshot.

target.description: Playwright selector or aria-ref=<ref> matching one element; omitted reads the page.

depth.description: Snapshot depth before search; unlimited if omitted. Ignored for other formats.

boxes.description: Include viewport bounding boxes in snapshots; ignored for other formats.

search.description: Snapshot-only Python regex; case-sensitive unless (?i). No matches returns empty text.

main_content_only.description: Clean body/target content for AI; ignored for snapshots.

name: browser_actions
title: Browser actions
description:
Run mouse, field, key, dialog, and wait actions in order; return plain text without a snapshot.
Stop on the first error, identifying its action; partial effects remain. No retries.
Element mouse targets auto-wait and scroll into view; coordinates and wheel do not wait for navigation or scrolling.
Cancelled/timed-out clicks attempt button release. Load waits observe the current document, not future navigation.

actions.description: Ordered actions; fields need target; mouse needs target or viewport (x, y).

slowly.description: Fresh random delays: 50-150 ms per character, 100-300 ms between all actions, including waits.

name: browser_evaluate
title: Run JavaScript
description:
Run JavaScript on the current page, await promises, and return JSON text without a snapshot.
Return JSON-compatible values; null/undefined become null. Script effects are not undone on failure.
Cancellation stops waiting, but may not stop the script.

expression.description: JavaScript expression or function to invoke.

arg.description: JSON object passed to the function; use properties for scalar or array values.

isolated_context.description: False accesses the page's own JS variables; True uses a separate context with the same DOM.

name: browser_network_requests
title: List network requests
description: List completed requests across page changes, with IDs and pagination. Recording starts when the browser session opens.

after_id.description: Return requests with a higher ID; use next_cursor for more.

name: browser_network_request
title: Read network request
description: Read a complete saved request part without resending it, with structured data and availability notes.

part.description: Request summary, headers, or text body; incomplete headers are marked.

name: browser_screenshot
title: Take browser session screenshot
description:
Capture the current page or one element without navigating; return the image and current URL.
Element capture waits and scrolls into view. Use browser_actions for other waits before capture.

full_page.description: Capture the full scrollable page; incompatible with selector/ref.

timeout.description: Capture limit in milliseconds; 0 disables it.

selector.description: Playwright selector matching one element; omit when using ref.

ref.description: Current snapshot element reference; omit both targets for page capture.
